name: Reading Labels for Hidden Animal Products
equipment: A few packaged items from your pantry
instructions: Scan ingredient lists for less obvious animal-derived ingredients: whey, casein, gelatin, and some forms of vitamin D3 (D3 from lanolin vs. D2/vegan D3).
Look for a "certified vegan" or "plant-based" label when you want certainty without reading every ingredient.
Do not assume "dairy-free" means fully plant-based -- it only rules out dairy, not eggs, honey, or gelatin.
Watch today's video, then practice reading the label on one packaged food you buy regularly.
